invoice_behavior.description:
Indicates how mid-period quantity adjustments are invoiced.
**BILL_IMMEDIATELY**: Only available when collection schedule is `ADVANCE`. The quantity increase will be billed immediately on the scheduled date.
**BILL_ON_NEXT_COLLECTION_DATE**: The quantity increase will be billed for in-arrears at the end of the period.

is_prorated.description: Indicates if the partial period will be prorated or charged a full amount.

quantity_management_mode.description: Determines how the subscription's quantity is controlled. Defaults to QUANTITY_ONLY. **QUANTITY_ONLY**: The subscription quantity is specified directly on the subscription. `initial_quantity` must be provided with this option. Compatible with recurring commits/credits that use POOLED allocation. **SEAT_BASED**: Use when you want to pass specific seat identifiers (e.g. add user_123) to increment and decrement a subscription quantity, rather than directly providing the quantity. You must use a **SEAT_BASED** subscription to use a linked recurring credit with an allocation per seat. `seat_config` must be provided with this option.

initial_unassigned_seats.description: The initial amount of unassigned seats on this subscription.

seat_group_key.description: The property name, sent on usage events, that identifies the seat ID associated with the usage event. For example, the property name might be seat_id or user_id. The property must be set as a group key on billable metrics and a presentation/pricing group key on contract products. This allows linked recurring credits with an allocation per seat to be consumed by only one seat's usage.

starting_at_offset.description: Relative date from contract start date corresponding to the inclusive start time for the subscription. If not provided, defaults to contract start date

subscription_alias.description: Optional human-readable, per-package-unique alias for this subscription template. Lets a contract customization reference the subscription by alias instead of its template id.

billing_frequency.description: Frequency to bill subscription with. Together with product_id, must match existing rate on the rate card.

temporary_id.description: A temporary ID used to reference the subscription in recurring commit/credit subscription configs created within the same payload.

day.description: If not provided, defaults to the first day of the month.

invoice_generation_starting_at_offset.description: The offset at which Metronome should start generating usage invoices, relative to the contract start date.  If unspecified, contract start date will be used. This is useful to set if you want to import historical invoices via our 'Create Historical Invoices' API rather than having Metronome automatically generate them.

Explicit keys remain reserved after archive and replacements require a new key. Raw modes put the key inside their payload.

metronome_package.description: Metronome package. Prefer the typed package attribute, generated from CreatePackagePayload in the pinned OpenAPI spec. request and request_json remain for compatibility and API escape hatches. Destroy archives the package.

billable_metric_id.description: Required for USAGE; omit for other types.

metronome_product.description: A USAGE, FIXED, SUBSCRIPTION, or COMPOSITE Metronome product. Destroy archives the product.

fiat_per_custom_credit.description: Positive finite fiat minor units per custom credit, e.g. 2 USD cents per AI credit.

credit_type_conversions.description: Custom pricing-unit conversions into fiat minor units. Changing this immutable conversion list replaces the card. Omitted conversions are unmanaged; explicit lists track only their listed credit types.

credit_type_id.description: Metronome credit type ID. Omit to use the account's default USD (cents) credit type.

price_cents.description: Legacy convenience: minor units per metric unit. Required with usage_product_id.

rate_mode.description: Provider tracking mode: none, legacy, or list.

billing_frequency.description: Required for a FLAT rate on a SUBSCRIPTION product (e.g. MONTHLY).

credit_type_id.description: Defaults to the rate card's credit type.

price.description: Minor units for FLAT; fractional percentage for PERCENTAGE.

rate_type.description: FLAT or PERCENTAGE. FLAT with billing_frequency prices a SUBSCRIPTION product.

rates.description: Explicit rates to add when creating the card. Each is an addRate API call. Rates cannot be deleted individually; replacing the card archives it.

starting_at.description: UTC hour-boundary effective timestamp. Omit to start at the beginning of the current UTC hour when created.

usage_product_id.description: Legacy convenience: usage product for a single FLAT rate. Omit to create the card alone.

metronome_rate_card.description: A Metronome rate card with optional explicit rates or one legacy entitled FLAT rate. External add_rate actions are appropriate when rates are unmanaged or outside the managed product/start/frequency entries. Changes to managed rates can require card replacement. Destroy archives the card.
